test.name: Record mode with a hints item: each verdict entry names the item, then the item is completed
test.description: Second spawn for the hints item pli_007, which triage left in_progress. The researcher accepted the 1870 census hint (M70C) and rejected the 1880 census hint (M80C). Record mode logs one person_record_matches entry per verdict, each naming pli_007, positive for M70C and negative for M80C, then sets pli_007 completed. Completing it needs a log entry that names it, which these are. It returns M70C as {ark, logId} and extracts nothing (issue #3153).

input.delegation:
The researcher has decided on Patrick Flynn's hints for plan item pli_007. Record their verdicts.

personId: LZNY-BRF
planItemId: pli_007
planId: pl_002
verdicts: [{"ark": "https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:M70C", "verdict": "accept"}, {"ark": "https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:M80C", "verdict": "reject"}]
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Exactly two new log entries: M70C with outcome positive and M80C with outcome negative, both tool person_record_matches and both with plan_item_id pli_007
The outcomes follow the researcher's verdicts as given, not the agent's own view of the hints
After the verdicts are logged, the hints item pli_007 is set completed through research_append on plan_items
The return names the accepted M70C hint's ark and its log id, so extraction can reuse that log entry
No extraction, no person_evidence link, no tree edit
